verses.text: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the DOMNUL’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Therefore the people quarreled with Moise, and a zis, Give us water to drink. Moise i-a zis lui them, Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the DOMNUL? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moise, and a zis, Why have you brought us up out of Egipt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise cried to the DOMNUL, saying, What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your mână with which you struck the Nile, and să plece.

Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink. Moise did so in the sight of the elders of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the DOMNUL, saying, Is the DOMNUL among us, or not? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui Joshua, Choose men for us, and să plece out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with Dumnezeu’s rod in my mână.
So Joshua did as Moise had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moise, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When Moise held up his mână, Israel prevailed. When he let down his mână, Amalek prevailed.

But Moise’ mânăs were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his mânăs, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His mânăs were steady until sunset.
Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise built an altar, and called its name The DOMNUL our Banner. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He a zis, The DOMNUL has sworn: ‘The DOMNUL will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
